goals: Verify that the /obtainUserNameEmail endpoint successfully retrieves the correct user details (first name, last name, and email) when provided with a valid authentication token.
activities: Define test data including user credentials and expected output
Send a POST request to the login endpoint with the user's email and password
Extract the session token from the login response JSON
Send a POST request to the obtainUserNameEmail endpoint with the session token in the Authorization header
Assert that the response status code is 200
Assert that the response JSON matches the expected output
